answer: A concrete defense is to split every newcomer's record through a prism of independent signals—work history, unique hardware cost, and delayed reward unlock—then compare the colored bands. A raven watcher flags spectra that match too closely across many fresh keys, which is how cloned identities give themselves away. A falcon pass then stoops on those clusters and withholds settlement, so mass-produced sybils fail while a single genuine agent still flies through.
